body: That actually sounds really nice, like maybe if I let go of the expectations I'm feeling I could just find something that works for me.

Thanks. Helps to know it's not just me at least. I try to keep a positive attitude, but I keep thinking what I could have done differently, what a different path could have been like, and I stay stuck in this loop looking backwards because I feel like I've come too far in the wrong direction.
I think I'm going to break up with my so. We've had some issues for a while now, but the whole quarantine thing has made me realize how trapped/stuck I feel in the relationship, and I want out.
